title: BUDGET_FLOOR.json - exploration budget floor completion criteria
description: Machine-readable form of the exploration budget floor (experiment-execution SKILL.md, 'Exploration Budget Floor'). Hard rules enforced by the validator as post-checks: budget_floor.satisfied=false forbids verdict PASS (only IN_PROGRESS or BLOCKED allowed); declaring completion (verdict PASS) requires completion_justification. The 5 check items (routes explored, matrix completion, seed budget, failure records, remaining-budget declaration) are documented semantically but their exact field names are not fixed by the docs - see schemas/README.md known gaps.

verdict.description: Return-payload verdict. PASS = floor satisfied and completion justified; IN_PROGRESS = keep exploring; BLOCKED = resource/direction limited (attach reason).

satisfied.description: True only when all 5 floor checks pass (routes explored >= 2 or rejection evidence, matrix 100%, seeds complete, failures recorded, remaining budget declared).

completion_justification.description: Mandatory when declaring completion: list of attempted routes + status of each (success / rejected+evidence) + remaining untried routes (must be empty or justified one by one). Shape not fixed by the docs, so presence-only is enforced (by validator post-check when verdict=PASS).
